releases.name: opencode-optmem v0.1.0
releases.body:
Initial public release of `opencode-optmem`.

### Included

- Native `optmem_*` tools for OpenCode agents
- Permanent memory loaded automatically in primary sessions
- Optional TUI browser for memories and the OptMem summary tree
- Process limits, cancellation, and safe handling of memory as untrusted data

### Install

Add `opencode-optmem` to the OpenCode plugin array. To enable the dashboard, add `opencode-optmem/tui` to the TUI plugin array.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/gustavo-ferreira03/opencode-optmem/blob/v0.1.0/INSTALL.txt) for the complete setup.
